messages:
maureen: Heads-up — RC py-sdk regressed: init kwarg ordering can cause route header to be dropped. Console shows route_meta=null for affected requests.

devon: can you paste a repro?

maureen: repro:``python
from redwood import Client
# working
c = Client(api_key="sk_live", default_route="acct-42")
c.generate("hi")
# broken
c = Client(default_route="acct-42", api_key="sk_live")
c.generate("hi")
# server sees no x-route header
```

anya: likely an __init__ ordering bug where kwargs normalize runs before auth fields are set. I suspect commit d4f3a2bf.

kevin: quick bisect confirms that commit. normalize_kwargs() called too early and _parse_route_hint reads instance attrs not yet assigned.

devon: options: revert & ship patch, or add server tolerant fallback (map legacy query param) while SDK patch lands. Revert is fastest for hosted.

maureen: reverting is safest. For Dedicated/Private, enable server-side fallback for ~48-72h to avoid disruption. Need telemetry tag to mark affected requests so console dashboards can filter.

kevin: I'll open the revert PR and include a unit+integration test covering init-order. Also add a CI lint to prevent referencing normalized kwargs before auth set.

oliver: I can add a temporary console tile: filter where route_meta is null, group by sdk.name + sdk.version, last 1h. Will add alert if >0.5% in 5m. Tagging maureen when ready.

maureen: opened PR https://git.internal/redwood/py-sdk/pull/4302 reverting and adding tests.

deploy-bot: Canary queued: py-sdk v0.9.1-canary -> willary group. status: started.

devon: also watch quotas: missing route may misattribute tenant usage; schedule quota reconciliation for the last 3h window.

kevin: scheduled a recon job; will post results in ~40m. If we see misattribution we'll backfill metrics and notify CS.

maureen: pinging @lina for release notes + Dedicated advisory.

lina: noted. drafting short advisory + hosted changelog entry: upgrade to 0.9.1+; avoid relying on kwarg ordering; server fallback window details.

anya: follow-up: add an SDK unit that asserts header emission regardless of kwarg order and a small fuzz test for Client(...) variations.

kevin: will add both to the PR. keeping thread open until canary + recon green.
